name: goedu
description: GoEdu - Online Courses in Bangladesh with Certificates. Full-stack LMS (React + Tailwind frontend, Node.js/Express + MySQL backend).

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
